title: Learnings and Pitfalls from AI-Assisted A/B Experimentation at Scale
abstract: arXiv:2611.04515v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A/B testing underpins product decisions by providing trustworthy, reproducible quantification of proposed changes' effects. Growing large language model (LLM) capabilities have motivated efforts to automate experimentation workflows. Yet LLMs are nondeterministic and prone to hallucination, properties that conflict with the trust experimentation systems must provide. Experiments are also operationally messy: diagnosing anomalies, debugging configurations, and conducting bespoke follow-up analyses require flexible reasoning and manual effort. These tasks let agents accelerate experimentation without replacing its deterministic statistical foundations.   We report lessons from building and operating such an agent. Our central finding is that this tension is resolved not by making the model deterministic, but by bounding where its nondeterminism can reach; the model selects and sequences procedures, while deterministic code computes eve

translated_title: 大规模AI辅助A/B实验的经验教训与陷阱
translated_abstract: A/B测试通过提供可信、可复现的量化方式来评估产品变更的效果，从而支撑产品决策。大语言模型（LLM）能力的快速提升推动了实验工作流自动化的尝试。然而，LLM具有非确定性和易产生幻觉的特性，这与实验系统所必须提供的可信度相冲突。此外，实验在操作层面也十分繁琐：诊断异常、调试配置以及开展定制化的后续分析都需要灵活的推理和大量人工投入。这些任务恰好可以让智能体在不取代确定性统计基础的前提下加速实验流程。我们报告了构建和运营此类智能体所获得的经验教训。我们的核心发现是：这一矛盾并非通过使模型变得确定性来解决，而是通过限制其非确定性的作用范围来解决——即由模型负责选择和排序实验流程，而由确定性代码完成所有计算。
tldr: 该论文总结了构建和运营大规模AI辅助A/B实验智能体的经验与陷阱，核心结论是通过限制LLM非确定性的作用范围（模型负责选择与编排流程，确定性代码负责计算）来化解LLM不可靠性与实验系统可信度之间的矛盾。
en_tdlr: This paper reports lessons and pitfalls from building an AI agent for large-scale A/B experimentation, showing that the tension between LLM nondeterminism and experimental trustworthiness is resolved not by making the model deterministic, but by bounding where its nondeterminism can reach—letting the model select and sequence procedures while deterministic code performs the computations.
